..Title
Resolution to Approve an Easement Agreement for Water Main at 3125 Hunting Valley Road (8 Votes Required)
..Memorandum
This easement agreement is executed to allow a proposed building encroachment into an existing water main easement. The water main is proposed to be replaced and relocated elsewhere in 2028 as part of the City's Capital Improvement Project (UT-WS-24-03). The property owners are requesting a new garage addition that will encroach into the existing easement and are willing to grant the new relocated easement once drawings are available for the Capital Improvement Project (UT-WS-24-03).
..Staff
Prepared by:  	Michele Yanga, Paralegal
Reviewed by:  	Christopher Frost, Senior Assistant City Attorney
      Kevin Kim, Assistant City Attorney
Approved by:  	Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, John K. Morris and Michelle X. Morris, are the owners of property commonly known as 3125 Hunting Valley Road, Ann Arbor, Michigan 48104; and

Whereas, John K. Morris and Michelle X. Morris have signed an easement agreement for water main and appurtenances as shown and described in the attached easement and map:

An easement for water main reserved in Liber 1399, Page 369, Washtenaw County Records; and

Commencing at the East 1/4 corner of Section 34, Town 2 South, Range 6 East, City of Ann Arbor, Washtenaw County, Michigan; thence North 00 degrees 55 minutes West 964.02 feet, thence North 82 degrees 16 minutes West 64.78 feet; thence South 13 degrees 54 minutes West 0.57 feet; thence along the northerly line of Hunting Valley Subdivision No. 2, as recorded in Liber 15 of Plats, page 47, Washtenaw County Records, South 80 degrees 02 minutes West 161.46 feet for a Place of Beginning of a 60.00 foot wide Water Main Easement; thence continuing along the northerly line of said Hunting Valley Subdivision No. 2, South 80 degrees 02 minutes 00 seconds West 70.52 feet; thence North 41 degrees 40 minutes 09 seconds West 184.28 feet; thence North 50 degrees 47 minutes 31 seconds East 60.06 feet; thence South 41 degrees 40 minutes 09 seconds East 218.76 feet to the place of beginning.
 
RESOLVED, That the City of Ann Arbor hereby approves the attached easement agreement; 

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and Clerk are authorized to sign the easement agreement after approval by the City Administrator and City Attorney;

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator is authorized to take all appropriate actions to implement this resolution and the easement agreement, exercise all determinations and authority delegated to the City under the easement agreement, and draft, execute, record, and manage all ancillary documents, instruments, and agreements after approval by the City Attorney.
